actions.label: slide-right
actions.instruction: 用右侧机器人手抓住黄色碗的把手，先轻轻抬离桌面，再把碗搬到画面右侧目标区并保持。
actions.prompt: In a fixed real laboratory camera view, a coherent silver dexterous robot arm grasps the yellow handled bowl, lifts it slightly off the metal table, carries it along a smooth arc to the upper-right target, and holds it there. Generate natural continuous shoulder, elbow, wrist, palm, and finger articulation. Keep the hand attached to the forearm with exactly one stable five-finger robot hand, preserve causal bowl contact, and keep the real camera and background unchanged.
